record.title: ROBOTIS DYNAMIXEL XL330-M288-T - three wires on a JST EH: GND, VDD, DATA (half-duplex TTL, Protocol 2.0)

requires.name: DATA
requires.quote: TTL Multidrop Bus (3.3V Logic, 5V Compatible) / TTL Half Duplex Asynchronous Serial Communication (8bit, 1stop, No Parity)
requires.address_basis: THE BUS ID IS A REGISTER, NOT A FIXED ADDRESS. E1 §Control Table 'ID | RW | 1 | 0 ~ 252'; §ID(7): '254(0xFE) is occupied as a broadcast ID' (chips[XL330-M288-T].bus_id). Every servo of this type ships at ID 1 and is programmed to its place on the bus, so this record states NO address; the design that wires fifteen of them states each ID as its own assertion (electronics/netlist.py, IDs from research/raw/duck-control_src_model.rs:15-19 JOINT_IDS). Added 2026-09-02, netlist lane — additive, no key renamed.

record.note: Multidrop: one DATA line carries up to 253 IDs; the Microduck puts 15 servos plus the imu_to_dxl board (ID 200) on it at 1 Mbps. The host needs the half-duplex converter in chips[XL330-M288-T].communication_circuit; the Microduck's Robot HAT is assumed to carry one (transceiver part CANNOT DETERMINE).
uncertainties: chips[XL330-M288-T].current_mA.typical is null - no running current is published; a rail budget over 15 servos has only idle (17 mA) and stall (1.47 A at 5 V) to work from.
The design's VDD (pack, 6.6-8.2 V) is above supplies[0].v_max = 6.0 V; the check that reads this record must FAIL or CANNOT DETERMINE that rail, not pass it.
